title: 観音扉付きロールボックス台車
description: 店舗の搬入口・荷さばき場で荷物をまとめて運ぶ背の高いかご台車。厚い荷台と四キャスター、三面の実ワイヤー格子、左右の押し手、二枚扉のうち一枚を開いた固定姿勢、蝶番・掛け金を造形。買い物カートと異なる立方体状の搬送囲いで、荷物は含みません。扉・車輪は静止し、荷重や搬送安全の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.896 × 1.745 × 1.088 m、23,064三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A tall roll cage for grouped goods at shop loading entrances and dispatch areas. It has a thick load deck, four casters, three real wire-grid sides, pushing handles and two front doors with one fixed open, plus hinges and latches. Its cubic transport enclosure is distinct from a shopping basket trolley; cargo is absent. Doors and wheels are static, with no load or transport-safety validation. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.896 × 1.745 × 1.088 m; 23,064 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
